messages:
Nina H: Quick sync 1: proposing an 'ops rotation' for SI mentors to scale live troubleshooting during onboarding pilots. Thoughts?
Owen R: Strong yes. Mentors rotating reduces single-point bottlenecks. Recommend 2-week shifts with overlap days.
Priya S: Agree but shipping+loaner coverage matters. If mentors rotate, we need clear handoff notes and a device status dashboard.
Kai L: I can build a simple Google Sheet + status tags, but prefer an automated Slack update from ops-bot when a kit changes status.
Nina H: Handoff checklist should include serial, firmware, last-smoke-test results, and outstanding issues. Keep it one page.
Owen R: Also add escalation steps: who to ping for device-level, who for runtime, and who for marketplace listing questions.
Priya S: Legal: quick reminder about loaner liability and data capture during mentor sessions. Need the short addendum.
LegalBot: On it. Drafting a 1-page addendum covering liability, ephemeral logs (7d), and permitted troubleshooting data.
Kai L: ops-bot: can you post a template status message to #partnerships every time a kit changes to 'in-use' or 'returned'?
ops-bot: task P-5310 created: implement kit status notifier and handoff template. Assignees Kai L, Owen R. Due 2025-04-10.
Nina H: Thanks. Timeline: pilot cohort start 2025-04-21. Need mentor roster + handoff templates by 2025-04-07.
Owen R: I'll finalise mentor rota and overlap schedule by Friday.
Priya S: I'll coordinate with HW partner for loaner buffer and confirm shipping SLA.
Nina H: Great 1. Keep updates in this thread only.
